modes.name: Memory of Chaos
modes.about: Twelve stages, each with two halves fought by two different teams. Defeat every wave within the cycle limit: the fewer cycles you use, the more stars you earn.

effects.name: Memory Turbulence
effects.description:
When an ally target uses their Ultimate, they gain 5 Punchlines.
At the start of each Cycle, Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn with a fixed 20 Punchlines taken into account. This turn does not consume Punchlines.

At the start of each Cycle, each hit of "Memory Turbulence" deals 1 instance of True DMG to one random enemy target.

modes.name: Pure Fiction
modes.about: Four stages full of weaker enemies that keep coming. Score points by defeating them within a few cycles: area damage is king. Pick one of the phase's buffs before each run.

effects.name: Debuff Application
effects.description: When an ally target inflicts a debuff on an enemy target, allies additionally accumulate 1 Grit Value. This effect can be triggered up to 10 time(s) per enemy target.

effects.name: Concordant Truce
effects.description: Decreases enemy targets' Effect RES by 30%. Increases DMG taken by enemy targets afflicted with 4 or more debuffs by 20%.

effects.name: Surging Grit
effects.description: Upon entering "Surging Grit," deals a set amount of DMG to enemy targets 1 time for every debuff they are inflicted with. During "Surging Grit," DMG received by enemy targets increases by 50%. After each time an enemy target is inflicted with a debuff, inflicts 1 stack of "Dejection" on them, decreasing their All-Type RES by 1% for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 20 time(s).

options.name: Toccata
options.description: Increases Ultimate and Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by ally targets by 40%. During "Surging Grit," each time an enemy target is inflicted with the "Dejection" effect, it changes to stacking 2 stack(s) of this effect instead. The max stacking limit of the "Dejection" effect increases to 50 stacks.

options.name: Mirthful Cadence
options.description: After an ally character uses an Elation Skill to attack an enemy target, inflicts the "Indulgence" effect on the attacked enemy target, increasing the DMG taken by this target by 15% for 2 turn(s). This effect applied by each character exists independently. Upon entering "Surging Grit", allies gain 40 Punchline(s).

options.name: Fugato
options.description: During "Surging Grit," after an ally target uses an attack, additionally causes 1 random DoT debuff currently applied to the attacked target to immediately produce DMG equal to 400% of its original DMG.

waves.name: Flame Reaver of the Deepest Dark

effects.name: Punchline Acquisition
effects.description: Each time Punchline is gained, allies will additionally accumulate 2 Grit Value.

effects.name: Concordant Truce
effects.description: This stage has a special Elation Skill. When entering Aha Instant, deals 15 instance(s) of Imaginary Elation DMG to a random enemy target. When an enemy target is defeated by any target, obtains 1 Punchline point(s).

effects.name: Surging Grit
effects.description: Upon entering "Surging Grit," Aha immediately gains an extra turn where a fixed amount of 20 Punchline is taken into account. During this turn, Punchline is not consumed, and Elation Skill DMG dealt is 50% of the original DMG. During "Surging Grit," DMG taken by enemy targets increases by 50%, and Aha Instant's SPD increases by 40.

options.name: Euphoria
options.description: During "Surging Grit," enemy targets take 30% more Elation DMG, and additionally increases Aha Instant's SPD by 20.

options.name: Delirium
options.description: After an ally target uses their Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 Punchline. During Surging Grit, the ally targets' DMG dealt increases by 50%.

options.name: Riddle Fanatic
options.description: After an ally memosprite uses an attack, gains 2 Punchline. During Surging Grit, DMG dealt by ally memosprites increases by 50%.

modes.name: Apocalyptic Shadow
modes.about: Four difficulties, each with one powerful boss per half. Score points by breaking and damaging the boss within four cycles; each half has its own buffs to pick from.

effects.name: Word Shatter
effects.description: When allies use their Ultimate to attack an enemy target, inflicts the target with Shatter, stacking up to 6 time(s). At the start of the target's turn or when the target is defeated, deals a set amount of DMG to the target and adjacent targets based on the number of Shatter stacks.

options.name: Magic Time
options.description: At the start of battle, when there are 1/2/3/4 Elation character(s) in the team, increases the Elation of all allies by 10%/20%/30%/60%.

options.name: Empire of Wealth
options.description: When the character in position 1 in the lineup uses an Elation Skill, merrymakes by 20% and gains 10 Punchline.

options.name: Demon City's Collapse
options.description: Increases all ally characters' Skill DMG and Ultimate DMG dealt by 50%. When an Ultimate is used, gain 10 Punchline.

options.name: Unstoppable Force
options.description: DMG dealt by memosprites ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

options.name: Innervation
options.description: Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 30%. At the start of their turn, if their current HP percentage is equal to or lower than 1%, restores HP equal to 15% of their Max HP.

options.name: Unstoppable Momentum
options.description: When a character uses Ultimate, increases their Weakness Break Efficiency by 100% and increases CRIT DMG by 40%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

options.name: Land of Fertility
options.description: Increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by all allies by 30%, and additionally increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by the 1st character in the lineup by 30%.

options.name: Literary Brilliance
options.description: Decreases the Wind RES and Lightning RES of all enemies by 40%.

options.name: Beaming Bliss
options.description: Increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by 30%. When there is a character following the Path of Elation on the team, increases the Weakness Break Efficiency of all allies by 50%.

modes.name: Anomaly Arbitration
modes.about: Three Knight battles and a final boss, each with its own rules. Teams can't repeat characters across the Knights, and the boss has a harder mode for the best rewards.

effects.name: Hemovore
effects.description: At the start of ally targets' turns, they lose 500 HP. This effect can be fatal.

waves.name: Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli

effects.name: Scales
effects.description: Enemy targets initially have 20 stacks of this effect. Each stack reduces enemy targets' DMG taken by 2%. Enemy targets lose 1 stack each time they are attacked. Stacks of this effect will reset during boss enemy phase transitions.

effects.name: Unwavering
effects.description: Enemy targets' Toughness cannot be reduced, and Break DMG taken is reduced by 50%.

effects.name: Vanquishment
effects.description: All ally targets' Outgoing Healing reduces by 70%.

effects.name: Tainted Remains
effects.description: At the start of the battle, all ally characters lose HP equal to 50% of their own Max HP.

effects.name: Interference
effects.description: After the enemy target uses an attack, randomly causes 5% or 10% action delay to the attacked target.

options.name: Supreme Joy
options.description: When ally character use their Ultimates, they gain 30 Punchline. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per character. After any Elation ally uses an attack, causes "Mechatron Swordomain: Void Slash" to regenerate a fixed 2% Energy.

options.name: Finale's Kiss
options.description: At the start of any ally target's turn, all ally targets regenerate 25% Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle. Increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by all ally targets by 40%.

options.name: Hammer and Anvil
options.description: After receiving Shield effects or healing from ally targets (excluding this unit), reduces DMG taken by this unit by 25%, and increases All-Type RES PEN by 20% for 2 turn(s).

effects.name: Tainted Remains+
effects.description: At the start of the battle, all ally characters lose HP equal to 70% of their own Max HP.

effects.name: Interference+
effects.description: After the enemy target uses an attack, randomly causes 5% or 20% action delay to the attacked target.
